text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out with Fuji Kiseki, we ran into 
Curren Chan.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, fancy meeting you here, Curren. What 
were you up to?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking photos for Umastagram☆ The 
sweets here are trending for being totally 
"photogenic"~

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Fuji-san, you're on Umastagram 
too, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, why don't you join us? Your 
Trainer is welcome too, of course♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right. Everything on the menu 
here certainly looks dazzling and 
photogenic.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪ Well then, for now let's take a solo 
shot—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splash)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, just as I thought. Fuji-san 
really is amazing, isn't she?♪"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, the angle, the lighting 
awareness, the facial expressions, and how 
well you handle the special 'With Curren' 
situation—everything is flawless!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: As expected of @DREAM_MAKER♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You comment every now and then, 
don't you? Thank you, "@Curren".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki's Umastagram account, 
"@DREAM_MAKER", is filled with photos 
carefully posed and edited to evoke a 
powerful sense of narrative.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, I secretly follow her, and 
it was immediately apparent that she 
enjoys immense popularity among fans who, 
true to her name, have been whisked away 
to a dream world.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Fuji-san, you don't 
use Umatter?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I think everyone wants to see a more 
casual, everyday side of you, Senpai♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Do you wish to touch me? To reach the 
innocent me who has stepped off the stage, 
stripped away the costume, and cast aside 
all masks?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
""Still, I shall not forgive you. I will 
not. For the sweeter the fragrance of the 
hidden truth, the more deeply you are 
ensnared by the phantasmal invitation.""

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I won't forgive you. I'll never let you 
go, never—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa. ...What a nice photo.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"It feels like I can almost hear those 
lines from earlier... It's dramatic... but 
doesn't it feel 'raw'?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I will always give the audience what they 
desire. However, crushing their dreams is 
the one thing I will never choose to do.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much you ask of me, this is 
the one thing— It's my pride, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Fuji-san—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Plus, y'know, since it's so easy to 
tweet on Umatter, it feels like you might 
accidentally show too much of your real 
self, right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I'm still just an inexperienced student 
myself, after all, fufu! It's an insurance 
policy so I don't get too carried away."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see. ...I'm learning a lot♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, on the way back.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, don't you use social 
media, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: Guess I'm just more of a spectator, huh?
If it's a blog to keep records...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you do check it! Does that mean you 
also look at my Umastagram—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I see. ...So that was it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's great to hear! ♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days after that exchange—

text_block_list.name: @Dreamer4385
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't Fuji-sama's post today totally 
insane?!"

text_block_list.name: @PrisonerSheep21
text_block_list.text: "I want to take... that hand so baaaad!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A masterstroke of a photo that practically 
whispered, "Walk with me," went viral for 
the first time in the account's history...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a blog! What kind of records are you 
keeping?
choice_data_list: I wonder if it's about training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained that I was writing it down as 
a memo to organize what I had learned and 
noticed.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Is that something it's okay for me to 
see?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking there was probably nothing 
interesting to see, I showed it to her, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... I see. You've been carrying this 
much——

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No... It's nothing. It just made me want 
to live up to everyone's hopes all over 
again.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, let's hurry home, Trainer! We'll 
rest up and train again tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Alongside a cheerfully smiling Fuji 
Kiseki, we made our way back home.
